claude-fable-5-1.notes: Successor to Fable 5 in the same tier at the same per-token price. Thinking always on — omit the thinking param entirely (an explicit budget_tokens or disabled 400s). Cache reads cost 2.5% of the input price on this model, not the 10% this file's global cache_read_multiplier (0.1) applies, and there is no per-model override, so every reader in this repo OVER-estimates Fable 5.1 cache-read cost by 4× until one exists. Forced tool_choice (any or tool) 400s — leave it auto. Thinking blocks are bound to the model that produced them; do not replay them to another model. Requires 30-day data retention (no ZDR). Refusal classifiers on cyber/bio-adjacent work — handle stop_reason 'refusal'. Same tokenizer as Fable 5 / Opus 4.8. Retirement not sooner than 2027-09-01.

claude-fable-5.notes: Still served; superseded by Fable 5.1 at the same rate. Thinking always on (omit thinking param). Refusal classifiers on cyber/bio-adjacent work. Requires 30-day data retention (no ZDR). Turns can run many minutes at high effort. Same tokenizer as Opus 4.8.

claude-opus-5.notes: Most capable Opus-tier model, at the same rate as Opus 4.8 — a drop-in upgrade with no cost delta. Thinking is ON by default (omitting the param runs adaptive, unlike Opus 4.8 where it meant no thinking); thinking:disabled is rejected above 'high' effort. Full effort ladder through 'max'. Prompt-cache minimum is 512 tokens, half Opus 4.8's, so shorter prefixes now cache. Draws on its own rate-limit bucket, separate from the combined Opus 4.x pool. Elevated cybersecurity safeguards can return stop_reason 'refusal'; cyber-category refusals fall back to Opus 4.8.

claude-opus-4-8.notes: Superseded by Opus 5 at the same rate. Adaptive thinking only; no sampling params. Standard fallback target for Fable 5 and Opus 5 refusals.

claude-opus-4-7.notes: Previous-generation Opus. Kept here for costing historical transcripts.

claude-sonnet-5.notes: The launch intro rate became the base rate on the live page — 2 in / 10 out with no intro window, so a transcript dated inside the old window costs exactly what it costs today and no intro_pricing block is needed. Substantial improvement over Sonnet 4.6; near Opus 4.8 at higher effort levels. Default model on Free/Pro plans. New tokenizer: ~1.0-1.35x token counts vs Sonnet 4.6 — re-baseline with count_tokens. Weaker than Opus 4.8 on cybersecurity analysis.

claude-sonnet-4-6.notes: Superseded by Sonnet 5. Kept here for costing historical transcripts.

claude-haiku-4-5.notes: Fastest and cheapest. 200K context ceiling — not for large-repo agentic work. Best value in api mode for classification/extraction/bulk calls; effectively obsolete in subscription mode.
